title: The sheaf fibre product of algebraic spaces and its first projection
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], let $X,Y,Z$ be algebraic spaces over $S$ [def-trf-algebraic-space], and let $f:X\to Z$ and $g:Y\to Z$ be morphisms. Define $X\times_ZY$ as the pullback of their underlying sheaves on the big fppf site $(\mathit{Sch}/S)_{fppf}$ [def-pc-fppf-site], endowed with its algebraic-space property. Thus its sections over a scheme $T\to S$ are the pairs $(x,y)\in X(T)\times Y(T)$ with $f_T(x)=g_T(y)$, and restriction is componentwise. Define its first projection $\operatorname{pr}_1:X\times_ZY\to X$ by $(x,y)\mapsto x$.
